formulas.total_costs_expenses_and_other: total_cost_of_products_and_services_sold + rd + sga + impairment_of_assets_held_for_sale + other_income_net + interest_and_other_financial_charges

product_sales_yoy.description: Product sales YoY growth rate vs Q-4

service_sales_yoy.description: Service sales YoY growth rate vs Q-4

cogs_margin_delta_bps.description: Combined cost of products and services sold as % of net sales, delta vs Q-4

rd_yoy.description: R&D expenses YoY growth rate vs Q-4

sga_margin_delta_bps.description: SG&A expenses as % of net sales, delta vs Q-4

impairment_of_assets_held_for_sale_abs.description: impairment_of_assets_held_for_sale absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

other_income_net_abs.description: other_income_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

interest_and_other_financial_charges_yoy.description: interest_and_other_financial_charges YoY growth rate vs Q-4

income_before_taxes_abs.description: income_before_taxes absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

net_income_noncontrolling_interest_abs.description: net_income_noncontrolling_interest absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
